Cookies & browser storage

Last updated: 11 October 2026

Operator details pending. The highlighted fields must be completed by the website operator. These notices are drafts until the identifying and service-provider information is complete.

What the studio adds

The current public website does not add cookies, local storage, session storage, advertising tags, embedded social media or visitor analytics. Images, fonts and browser printing do not require a studio account. Opening the privacy notice or downloading a file does not mean you consent to optional tracking.

Hosting and technical information

GitHub Pages handles network requests and records IP addresses for security. Technical server logs are not the same as cookies. The hosting provider’s own practices are explained in the GitHub privacy statement. Links to external websites take you to their services, which may use their own cookies.

Consent choices

No optional cookie categories are enabled by the studio in this version, so there are no optional studio cookies to accept or reject. If non-essential storage or tracking is added later, it must remain disabled until any legally required consent is obtained. Accept and reject choices must be clear and equally easy, and withdrawal must be available. Continued browsing will not be treated as consent.

Your browser

You can inspect and delete site data through your browser settings. Saved drawings and cached images are handled by your browser; deleting cookies does not delete files you saved. If a future hosting configuration introduces additional cookies, this notice and any necessary controls must be updated.

Questions: contact the operator listed in the legal notice.
